gloss: cut-and-sewn top; knit top; T-shirt-style top

definitions.explanation: A top made by cutting and sewing knit fabric — covering T-shirts and other casual knit tops that are not a buttoned shirt or a sweater. A Japanese-coined fashion term (from English "cut and sewn").

examples.japanese: ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧カットソー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I put on a white knit top.

examples.japanese: ⟦ジャケット→ジャケット：04522_jaketto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧カットソー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。
examples.english: I'll pair a knit top under the jacket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無地|むじ}→無地：03990_muji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧カットソー⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{着回|きまわ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧きく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: Plain knit tops can be mixed and matched easily, so I have several of them.

notes:
Japanese-coined word (⟦{和製|わせい}{英語|えいご}→和製英語：18947_waseieigo⟧) from English "cut and sewn." A fashion-industry term that has spread into everyday use. The category includes T-shirts and other knit tops but excludes woven button-down shirts and bulkier knitwear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{無地|むじ}→無地：03990_muji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧カットソー: plain knit top
- ⟦{半袖|はんそで}→半袖：15518_hansode⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧カットソー: short-sleeve knit top
- カットソー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear a knit top
- カットソー⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: cut-and-sewn fabric

SIMILAR WORDS:
- Tシャツ: T-shirt — a specific type of カットソー with short sleeves and a crew neck
- ⟦ニット→ニット：08834_nitto⟧: knit; knitwear — heavier knit garments such as sweaters; カットソー is thinner and lighter
